turns.text: Cumulative production (kg) per 반응기 over 일자 — per-run production = 생산속도 × 가동시간 / 1000. One line per reactor, daily resolution.

spec.data_code:
df['daily_production_kg'] = df['생산속도 (g/h)'] * df['가동시간 (h)'] / 1000
df = df.sort_values(['반응기', '일자'])
df['cumulative_production_kg'] = df.groupby('반응기')['daily_production_kg'].cumsum()
spec.title: Cumulative Production per Reactor
